text: What's wrong with you, John? You look sick. I don't know what is wrong with me. Don't you have a cold? What is your symptom? I was shivering and it was cold last night. I think I have a headache too. I also snuffle and cough too. And I'm so tired. Oh, my goodness. I'm pretty sure you have a cold. What? It's not even winter yet, and the weather is warm, too. John, listen. It's warm in afternoon. But what about in morning? Isn't it cold? It's easy to catch a cold during the change of seasons. I did not know that. I thought I only catch a cold during the winter. You should drink lots of warm water and eat foods for vitamins. If you are not cured, you need to go to a hospital. Yeah, I should. When is the science homework due? Ouch. What's wrong? It hurts so much. I'm scared that this could be a serious one. Where? Did you get hurt? Look at this. John, I have a bandage. Don't be a crybaby. Achoo. Oops. What's wrong with you? Oh, no. I think I caught a cold from you. Achoo. Let's role play.
